author: Stahly
description:
I've been using the updated Vallejo Game Air range for over two years now, and here's what I've learned. How do they perform for zenithal base coats and detail work? Are they really as clog-free as promised, and how do they compare to other airbrush paints? I'll answer all of that in this long-term review.

The post The 2-year Vallejo Game Air long-term review appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The 2-year Vallejo Game Air long-term review
